fields.description: Linar brings high-rise waterfront living to Al Mamzar in Sharjah. Apartments and penthouses sit above shared leisure spaces, with landscaped routes, places to work and a mix of cafés and everyday services planned around the community.

sources.label: Linar: original launch factsheet, broker mirror
Al Mamzar: original launch presentation, broker mirror
Linar A, B and C: original apartment plans, broker mirror
Linar: broker payment and completion reference

overview: The planned community contains 2,620 homes across five residential towers and a separate commercial tower. The launch release describes towers of 50–55 floors; these figures represent the wider programme, not current inventory.
The current developer page includes four-bedroom penthouses alongside one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments. Published layouts below distinguish Towers A, B and C.
research.locationNote: The developer identifies Al Mamzar, Sharjah, with access from Corniche Road and Al Taawun Street. It is a Sharjah waterfront address, despite some broker pages applying Dubai registration advice.
research.priceNote: The current developer page advertises AED 945,000, compared with AED 849,000 in its June 2026 launch release. Neither establishes availability or the price of a selected residence.
research.paymentNote: The developer currently publishes 30 / 70. The table is a broker’s 10 / 20 / 70 reference. Property Finder instead lists 10 / 40 / 10 / 40; no original dated instalment calendar was retrieved to resolve that difference.
research.handoverNote: The June 2026 developer release expects Tower A to welcome residents from 2030 onwards. Property Finder lists Q4 2030, while another broker lists Q2 2031. A single confirmed completion quarter for all towers is unavailable.

facts.label: Planned programme
facts.value: 2,620 homes; five residential towers and one commercial tower.

facts.label: Tenure: developer launch statement
facts.value: Freehold ownership offered to all nationalities; confirm the selected title and contract.
